scope: STM32 link-only repair; existing fat LTO objects and all ROM/configuration/protocol/safety inputs retained. Local GCC 10.3.1 cross-builds and mock C safety checks, not target acceptance, printing performance approval, complete migration or merge readiness.
isolation: git archive of sourceBase plus src/stm32/Makefile only for firmware matrix; M2 drafts excluded. Host dependencies borrowed only for isolated development checks.

repair.change: Append -fuse-linker-plugin only to CFLAGS_klipper.elf after common non-plugin compile flags. Other board makefiles, source C and linker regions unchanged.
repair.cause: With the CI compiler, traditional collect2 preliminary non-LTO linking fails its ROM check before LTO can reduce the final code. Identical input objects with the linker plugin produce a successful normal link under the original region.
repair.minimumLinkerCapability: GNU ld plugin support (2.21+) or gold as documented by GCC; actual checked linker is GNU ld 2.38.

toolchain.installation: Official Ubuntu packages extracted under /tmp with temporary newlib include/lib symlinks; no system install.

comparison.scope: Old diagnostic executable is comparison-only, not accepted firmware. Normal plugin link is accepted locally with original ROM. Normalized disassembly comparison preserves instruction operands, canonicalizes LTO private symbol names and resolves relocated branch/literal targets; not physical target timing proof. Only ELF function symbols are selected; operation counts include instructions and literal pool directives.

hostRegression.coverage: Actual C output generation/defaults under UBSan and ASan+UBSan, thermocouple signed ranges/faults under UBSan, Node command dictionary/metadata/build CLI.

diagnosticBaseline.instrumentation: Temporary snapshot catches print original exceptions only on failure; expected stuck BLTouch logs its intended stop. Not a CI cause reproduction.

controlledDelay.scope: One discriminating event-loop delay experiment on the two failing cases; passes do not close remote failure or larger load cases.

probeInvestigation.testChange: On unexpected non-200 only, emit existing motion/hardware fault objects and hit counters with node:util inspect. No production algorithm, API payload, assert status, deadline, tolerance or stop behavior changed.

newDiagnosticsRegression.scope: Independent non-instrumented runtime snapshot, exact changed tests; M2 drafts excluded.

performance.scope: Static emitted-code comparison includes instructions and literal pools; symbols/relocated branch targets are normalized explicitly. Preserves operation counts/operands in 52 critical functions. Does not measure cache/layout effects, physical target execution, printing duration or target timing budget. Link/build durations are diagnostics only, no failed-link speed ratio reported.

remaining: Exact new PR-head full host/native protocol/sanitizer and entire firmware/legacy compatibility CI.
Two intermittent CI probe/calibration failures: inner-fault diagnostics added, cause and correction not yet established.
Historical G3 motion failures, physical board map/ROM/bootloader verification, target timing and printing acceptance.
M2 and remaining complete native Moonraker, controlled macros and all Python retirement.
archiveProvenance: Generated firmware version embeds archive build time without Git metadata; outputs are local verification artifacts, not release firmware.
